_comment: Fallback advisory set used only when OSV.dev is unreachable or offline mode is on. Not exhaustive - the live OSV query is always preferred. Ranges use npm semver syntax.

deprecated.request: request has been deprecated, see https://github.com/request/request/issues/3142 - use a maintained client such as axios, got or undici.
deprecated.node-sass: node-sass is deprecated. Migrate to the 'sass' (Dart Sass) package.
deprecated.moment: Moment is in maintenance mode and not recommended for new projects. Consider Luxon, Day.js or date-fns.
deprecated.istanbul: istanbul is no longer maintained. Use nyc or the built-in coverage of your test runner.
deprecated.gulp-util: gulp-util is deprecated and split into smaller modules.
deprecated.core-js@2: core-js@2 is deprecated. Upgrade to core-js@3.
deprecated.chokidar@2: chokidar 2 is unmaintained; upgrade to chokidar 3 or 4.
deprecated.uuid@3: uuid 3 is deprecated; upgrade to uuid 9+ for ESM and named exports.
deprecated.har-validator: har-validator is deprecated and no longer maintained.
deprecated.querystring: The core 'querystring' module is legacy; use URLSearchParams.
deprecated.resolve-url: resolve-url is deprecated; use the WHATWG URL API.
